clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter's long hours away from home, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir by September 1953 as her anxiety eased. Each shift in these months belongs to the family's adjustment to the move.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failure, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter's heavy drinking by June, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian's overfunctioning to manage the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's worsening asthma that winter, Nora's bed-wetting in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May, and Walter's return to work pruning other men's trees by October with his drinking stopped. The auction and move to Ridgeport in October sit within these months as the family's reactions to the loss of the orchard.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's loss of his job in February 1975 when the Ridgeport cannery closed: Glen's months out of work and sitting in the truck in the yard, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money, Marian's second job cleaning offices at night, Nora's loss of weight and poor eating that summer, Nora's distance from her mother and time kept to her room, Walter's return to drinking after six years off it by December, and Nora's recovery by June 1976 when she began eating again and made the track team as Glen started his delivery truck job. No other shifts show in these months beyond the family's own.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990 after selling her farm: Nora and Wilma's clashes over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis's distance from the conflict and late work, Hollis's alliance with his mother, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma's takeover of Lily's care, Nora's eczema flare on both hands, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights, and Nora's eczema clearing by August 1991 after Wilma took a flat in town in June. Marian's visits to take Nora's side in January 1991 sit within these months as the tension mounted.
